reason: Single large T2-hyperintense posterolateral thigh mass (about 440 mL) outlined in all three planes, including its lateral lobule and the mottled superior extension to about slice 178. Candidates C1-C5 were rejected: they are mainly the bright anterior tube, vessel-like branches and small blobs. Remaining uncertainty is whether the superior lace-like extension (slices 150-178) and the faint inferior tissue near slice 46 are tumour, and whether the boundary is slightly tight.
